input.summary:
P2 ground bedroom designed in parts/room-19.mjs: one red bed at x37 (head against the z18 partition, foot to the south window), a barrel dresser at (36,2,19) with a standing lantern on its lid. On a scratch copy that skips runParts' lock, `mcd room` says OK (walk ok, min light 11, FIT OK).
The part is NOT in build.nbt: runParts refuses both furniture writes and bedSet refuses the bed, because shell-west fills the interior box with air and the lock treats that air as placed. make.sh still exits 0 and writes a whole build.nbt.
Not ticked in plan.md or elements.md; the part is unfinished until the lock and the z18 partition are sorted.

waste.what: Worked out which interior cells are solid, free or locked by printing a block grid from build.nbt with a throwaway node script.
waste.tool: mcd cells build.nbt --box x0,y0,z0,x1,y1,z1 (block grid per y, with lock and wall-solid marks) would have replaced the probes.

waste.what: Bed placement by trial and error: a head against the window and a north-south bed at x36 both failed, and bedSet returns refused silently, so the build report never showed why.
waste.tool: A bed-site finder (bedSpot(g, box) listing every valid foot/head/facing with the reason it fails) and bedSet/dresser reporting refused cells in parts-report.json.

waste.what: Found the cause of 0 placed (the shell's air fill locks the room) only by reading shell-west.mjs and build.mjs runParts.
waste.tool: make.sh / runParts report should say which earlier part locked a refused cell, and mcd room should show the room's cells as locked before furnishing.

waste.what: Tested the design on a scratch copy by applying build() to build.nbt with no lock, plus a stand-in partition at z18.
waste.tool: mcd room --on-top <build.nbt> <part.mjs> (apply one part without runParts' lock, dry run) would have made this a single command.

companions.task: Build the solid partition at z18 across x36..37, y2..4 (the living room / bedroom wall with the door at (38,2..3,18)); the bed head depends on it.
Confirm the standing lantern on the barrel lid is the only light needed once the ceiling at y5 is built; if a hanging lantern is wanted, hang it from that block.

left: Not in build.nbt: runParts refuses the barrel and lantern writes ('REFUSED 2 writes ... air'), and bedSet refuses the bed silently. parts/shell-west.mjs:16 fills the whole interior box with air, and runParts locks air as placed, so every room part is locked out. Fix belongs to shell-west or runParts (let an uncut air fill stay writable), not to this module.

The bed head at (37,2,19) needs a solid cell at (37,2,18). No part builds the z18 partition between this bedroom and the living room (shell-west only clears air there). Someone must make x36..37, z18, y2..4 solid, or bedSet refuses the bed.

The bed moved from the spec's west wall to x37 against the north partition: the west wall x35 at z19..20 is the window pair, and bed() needs the two cells past the foot clear, which only x37 satisfies in this 3x2 room. Heads on west wall x36 is not possible.
The ceiling above y4 at z19..20 is not built in this copy (y5 is only built at z17..18), so the lantern stands on the barrel instead of hanging. Re-check once the upper floor is in.
Verified only on a scratch copy (/tmp/p26/test.nbt, applied without the lock with a stand-in z18 partition): mcd room OK, walk ok, min light 11, FIT OK. The real build still has none of this part.
plan.md checklist and the elements.md bed and lighting items are not ticked, because the part is not in the build.
